privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.s1Body: TrackrApp ("we", "our", or "us") is committed to protecting your personal information. This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, disclose, and safeguard your information when you use our service.
privacy.s2Intro: We collect information you provide directly to us, including:
privacy.s2Item2: Subscription data you enter (service names, prices, renewal dates)
privacy.s2Item3: Payment information processed via Stripe (we never store raw card data)
privacy.s2Item4: Profile information such as an avatar image
privacy.s2Technical: We also collect technical data automatically: IP address, browser type, pages visited, and crash reports. This helps us improve the service and diagnose issues.
privacy.s3Body: We use your information to: provide and improve the Service; send renewal reminder notifications; generate AI-powered insights (Pro plan); process payments; respond to support requests; detect and prevent fraud; and comply with legal obligations. We do not sell your data to third parties.
privacy.s4Intro: We share data only with trusted service providers who help us operate the Service, including:
privacy.s4Item4: AI providers (Anthropic/OpenAI) — Pro plan AI tips (anonymised subscription data only)
privacy.s5Body: We retain your data for as long as your account is active or as needed to provide the Service. When you delete your account, we delete or anonymise your personal data within 30 days, except where required by law to retain it longer (e.g., payment records for financial compliance).
privacy.s6Intro: Depending on your location, you may have the following rights under GDPR, CCPA, or other applicable law:
privacy.s6Item1: Access: request a copy of your personal data
privacy.s6Item3: Erasure: request deletion of your data
privacy.s6Item4: Portability: receive your data in a machine-readable format
privacy.s6Item5: Objection: opt out of certain processing
privacy.s6Item6: Restriction: limit how we process your data
privacy.s6Contact: To exercise any of these rights, contact us at privacy@trackrapp.xyz. We will respond within 30 days.
privacy.s7Body: We implement industry-standard security measures including encryption at rest and in transit (TLS 1.3), secure password hashing (argon2id), and regular security audits. No method of transmission over the internet is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.
privacy.s8Body: We may update this Privacy Policy periodically. We will notify you of material changes via email or prominent notice in the app. Continued use of the Service after changes constitutes acceptance of the updated policy.
privacy.s9Body: For privacy-related enquiries, contact us at privacy@trackrapp.xyz.
privacy.metaDescription: Learn how TrackrApp collects, uses, and protects your personal information.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.s1Body: Cookies are small text files stored on your device when you visit a website. They help websites remember your preferences, keep you signed in, and understand how you use the service. Cookies are not malware — they cannot execute code or transmit viruses.
cookies.s2Intro: TrackrApp uses the following types of cookies:
cookies.s2Item1: Strictly necessary: Session cookies required for authentication and security. These cannot be disabled.
cookies.s2Item2: Functional: Cookies that remember your preferences (e.g., dark mode, language). These improve your experience but are not required.
cookies.s2Item3: Analytics: Anonymised usage data to help us understand how the Service is used and improve it. No personally identifiable information is shared with analytics providers.
cookies.s3Intro: Some features of our Service use third-party services that may set their own cookies:
cookies.s3Item1: Stripe: Payment processing — sets cookies to detect fraud and manage checkout sessions
cookies.s3Item2: Google OAuth: If you sign in with Google, Google may set authentication cookies
cookies.s3Note: We do not use advertising or tracking cookies from ad networks.
cookies.s4Body: You can control and delete cookies through your browser settings. Most browsers allow you to refuse or accept specific types of cookies. Please note that disabling strictly necessary cookies may prevent you from signing in or using core features of the Service.
cookies.s4Intro2: To manage cookies in your browser, visit:
cookies.s4Chrome: Chrome: Settings → Privacy and security → Cookies
cookies.s4Firefox: Firefox: Settings → Privacy & Security → Cookies and Site Data
cookies.s4Safari: Safari: Settings → Privacy → Manage Website Data
cookies.s5Intro: Under the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR), EU/EEA residents have the right to:
cookies.s5Item1: Know what cookies and tracking technologies are used
cookies.s5Item2: Consent to or refuse non-essential cookies
cookies.s5Item4: Request deletion of data collected via cookies
cookies.s5Consent: By using TrackrApp, you consent to our use of strictly necessary cookies. For functional and analytics cookies, you may opt out by adjusting your browser settings as described above.
cookies.s6Body: We may update this Cookie Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our practices or applicable law. We will notify you of material changes via email or in-app notice.
cookies.s7Body: For questions about our use of cookies or this policy, contact us at privacy@trackrapp.xyz.
cookies.metaDescription: TrackrApp cookie policy and GDPR information.
